description: The cheapest way to buy a product Trueprice tracks (same as POST /api/v1/prices/optimize): the exact steps (sale, each code, shipping, tax, rewards) with each step's amount, source_id (the code's deals id or the product URL), confidence and checked_at, then checkout_total = items − eligible discounts + shipping + tax (tax only with user.taxRate), effective_cost after rewards (null without one), codes rejected and why (not stackable, minimum not met, new customers only, expired), assumptions, and snapshot_id: the purchase_paths row that reproduces every number. Maths is deterministic code, never a model; ranking never follows commission. Pass a product URL, or domain + handle, or your own offers/coupons/rewards. path is null when nothing is buyable.

coupons.description: {code, store, kind: percent|fixed|ship_percent|ship_fixed, value, min_spend?, stackable?, new_customer_only?, expires_at?}

offers.description: Your own offers: {store, url, price, checked_at, compare_at?, currency?, shipping?, available?, kind?, ref?}

rewards.description: {source, kind: percent|fixed, value, checked_at, store?, cap?, min_spend?}

url.description: Product page URL (a tracked Shopify store or any store page Trueprice tracks)

name: cheapest_path
title: Cheapest way to buy
